rec.name: PDP Multiple Product Videos (metaobject-driven section)
rec.status: Built — installed in live theme but hidden on PDP; customer actually wants a Block variant, awaiting customer feedback

what.text: A product-page section that shows several product videos per product. Each video is a metaobject entry (definition "CRO | PDP | Multiple Product Videos"). Entries are attached to a product through a product metafield, so every product can have its own set of videos. The section lives in the live theme as 'ed_cro_mp_videos_via_metafields'. The ticket does not describe the visual layout, and no screenshot shows the storefront UI.

why.text: Video shows size, texture, material and real-life use better than static photos. That lowers uncertainty and the perceived risk of buying online, which matters most for bulky home goods such as laundry baskets. Several videos per product (for example detail, scale, in use) cover different objections. This is general CRO reasoning; the ticket states no rationale.

how.text: 1) In Shopify admin > Settings > Custom data, create the metaobject definition 'CRO | PDP | Multiple Product Videos' (it appears in the store as 'Multipe Product video'). 2) Add one entry per video under Content > Metaobjects, named after the product. 3) On the product, connect the entries to the 'CRO | PDP | Multiple Product Videos' product metafield. 4) Add the section to the PDP template in the theme customizer. Build and test it in a copy of the live theme first, then hide or show it on the live PDP. A block version (shown under the product information) needs a separate build with the same logic but different markup; the developer estimated 1–2 hours.

items: Section visibility on the PDP (it was hidden after setup so visitors do not see incomplete content)
Per-product video entries via the metaobject-list metafield
Metaobject definition fields (exact field list not documented in the ticket)
Section vs. Block placement (the Block variant is not yet built)

dependencies.text: Needs store-admin access with 'Custom data' permissions (metafield and metaobject definitions, plus Products and Variants metafields); missing access blocked this ticket for about a month. Needs the metaobject definition 'CRO | PDP | Multiple Product Videos' and a product metafield that references its entries. Requires a Shopify Online Store 2.0 theme. Video source type and hosting (Shopify-hosted files or YouTube) are not stated.

items: PDP conversion rate (products with vs. without videos)
Add-to-cart rate on PDPs with videos
Video play rate and play-through rate
PDP bounce rate and time on page
Return rate on products with videos (optional)
